B: Panel B shows inspiratory and expiratory CT images of a symptomatic COPD patient with impaired physical activity. A chest X-ray showed a large right apical bulla with pleural-parenchymal changes and increased atelectasis of the adjacent lung, prominence of the main pulmonary artery, and emphysematous changes in the lungs (Figure 2).
